Date: 2027-04-07 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Sofia Patel (Staff Serving Eng) — proposed interview slots

Thanks Eli — resume looks solid. Quick calibration notes from HM perspective before we finalize schedule:

High-level leveling anchors (what I want interviewers to calibrate against):
- Scope: ownership across model serving stack (inference runtime + orchestration for multi-tenant environments). Look for examples where candidate influenced architecture and tradeoffs across teams.
- Complexity: depth in performance engineering (profiling, KV cache strategies, batching policies), not just surface-level optimizations.
- Impact: measurable outcomes (latency reductions, cost savings, production incident handling).
- Leadership: cross-team alignment, mentoring, deliberate tradeoff communication.

Interview focus by slot:
- System design (Laura): large-scale inference flow, failure modes, routing/fallbacks.
- Runtime & perf (Marissa): batching/caching heuristics, kernel/quantization decisions, benchmarks.
- Bar-raiser (Vanessa): leadership, ambiguity, escalation decisions, hiring bar.

Logistics asks:
- Please attach a simple timing matrix with 45/60 minute slots and a debrief placeholder (who runs debrief, expected outcome). I will own final debrief and hiring recommendation but would like Marissa to collect technical notes and Vanessa to summarize bar-raiser signal.

I prefer Option A (Tue 4/13) but can do B. Laura is softer on morning availability — if you can get candidate to confirm A, please schedule.

Markus Klein
Director, Serving Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, eli@talentco.io
Date: 2027-04-08 09:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Sofia Patel (Staff Serving Eng) — proposed interview slots

Thanks — attaching two quick artifacts: hm_anchor_matrix.xlsx and interview_timing_matrix.csv. I filled in preferred interview durations (45m for deep-dive technical, 60m for system design) and added a 30m debrief block immediately after the panel.

Proposed debrief choreography:
- 15m: each interviewer adds 2 bullet signals in the doc (strengths / risks)
- 10m: bar-raiser gives final read (pass / hold / fail) and key pivot question
- 5m: HM decides next step and action owner (offer / follow-up loop / decline)

I can take notes during interviews and upload timestamped highlights to the shared doc (link below). If Vanessa can take the bar-raiser slot I agree she should give the final read.

Attachments: hm_anchor_matrix.xlsx, interview_timing_matrix.csv

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

I can take bar-raiser. One tweak to anchors: add "tradeoff clarity" — i.e., can the candidate articulate why one path was chosen vs alternatives and what they would monitor in the weeks after rollout.

Also happy to run a 15m pre-brief with interviewers 30m before the panel to align the ask. Say the pre-brief is at 09:20 on Tue 4/13 if we go with Option A.

—Vanessa
